methods.name: with_header_size_hint
methods.summary: Provide a hint for the expected size of the Avro header in bytes. This can help optimize the initial read operation when fetching the header.

methods.name: with_projection
methods.summary: Specify a projection of column indices to read from the Avro file. This can help optimize reading by only fetching the necessary columns.

methods.name: with_range

methods.name: with_reader_schema
methods.summary: Specify a reader schema to use when reading the Avro file. This can be useful to project specific columns or handle schema evolution. If this is not provided, the schema will be derived from the Arrow schema provided.

methods.name: with_strict_mode
methods.summary: Enable strict mode for schema validation and data reading.

methods.name: with_tz
methods.summary: Sets the timezone representation for Avro timestamp fields.

methods.name: with_utf8_view
methods.summary: Enable usage of Utf8View types when reading string data.
